target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Current Kew native range is southwestern Canada to northern California; Texas is not included.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Current accepted native range excludes Texas.

morphology.look_here_first: Treat as a nursery/lookalike comparison only if encountered. It has pinnate evergreen leaves with many holly-like leaflets and blue-purple berry clusters, unlike the Central Texas native agarita/Texas barberry pair.
diagnostic_traits: not native to Texas under current Kew range

confusers.separator: Not a Texas native in the current accepted concept. Keep separate from B. swaseyi despite the historical Mahonia-style appearance.
